newsitem.title: GHANA: Slack session on Ghana Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Slack session on Ghana Stock Exchange.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange recorded another slack trading session on Wednesday with the share index hardly changed at the close.
The GSE All-Share Index edged up a fractional 0.15 points to 363,26 points. Two equities appreciated while none declined.
The total number of shares changing hands was a low 15,410 compared with Tuesday's 34,370.
Pioneer Tobacco Co gained 17 cedis to 172 cedis and conglomerate Unilever added 11 cedis to 821 cedis.
